gloss_en: Malkhut (the sefirah of Kingship, identified with prayer) in a state of lowliness and smallness (shiflut u-katnut) — the diminished, fallen Malkhut symbolized by the 'short wife,' the 'little sister,' and the 'small luminary' (the moon), which must be raised up (as in 'I will raise up the Sukkah of David') in Likutey Moharan I:49
